subject: Commercial package delivered — quick check on timing and walkthrough?
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Ellie Chen <ellie@brightleaf.ai>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial package for BrightLeaf — proposal + ops summary

Hi Ellie —

Thanks again for your time today. As promised, attaching the commercial package we discussed: pricing bands, estimated monthly costs under different traffic profiles, and a short ops appendix (latency SLOs, data residency options, and next-step checklist).

Key highlights: 
- 3 sizing options (pilot / scale / dedicated) with projected token costs per month
- Optional Dedicated cluster recommendation if you need steady throughput >500RPS
- 30-day pilot with rollback-friendly model pinning

Attachments: BrightLeaf_Commercial_Package_v2.pdf (summary + appendix)

If helpful I can run through the deck live — Diego can join for technical scoping. Would Thursday or Friday next week work for a 30-minute walkthrough?

Next steps I suggest:
1) You confirm which sizing band looks closest to your volume estimate
2) We schedule a 30-min walkthrough to align on integration and rollout
3) We propose a pilot timeline and draft MSA redlines (if needed)

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0134

Ellie — quick nudge on this thread. Wanted to check whether the commercial package landed and whether you had any initial thoughts on prioritization.

Short recap: we sent the pricing + ops package last Thursday (attached again below). If BrightLeaf is still evaluating, a 20–30 minute walkthrough tends to make the numbers more actionable and surfaces any ops questions early. Diego can cover integration and expected on‑prem/VPC networking work.

I realize timing can shift — if this isn’t a priority right now, a one-line update on decision timing would be super helpful so we don't keep pinging. If it is moving forward, here are two proposed slots for a quick walkthrough:
- Thursday 09/28, 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Friday 09/29, 02:00–02:30 PM PT

If neither works, tell me a couple windows that do and I’ll coordinate.

Attachment: BrightLeaf_Commercial_Package_v2.pdf (resent)

Thanks —
Monica
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0134
